structure_policy_rationale: Following the pattern of 'alipay' and 'douban', the core identity of Ximalaya lies entirely in the specific calligraphy/geometry of the character '听'. The theme rules dictate transforming flat characters into 3D ice sculptures while maintaining their exact 2D footprint. Therefore, the structure must be strictly preserved as a 3D extrusion of the original logo, ensuring immediate recognition despite the material change.
preserve: The exact geometry and stroke logic of the Chinese character '听'
The rounded corners of the strokes
The spatial gap/separation between the left radical '口' and right component '斤'
The overall rectangular silhouette formed by the character parts
must_preserve: The specific stroke width ratios of the '听' character
The closed loop structure of the left '口' radical
The horizontal-vertical skeletal relationship of the right '斤' component
Translucent ice blue/cyan material (NO red color)
recompose_allowed: Internal texture: embed subtle air bubbles or faint snowflake patterns within the ice volume
Surface details: add condensation droplets or frost textures on the surface
Base interaction: create a small melting water puddle or scattered ice chips at the base
restyle: Transform flat 2D vector shape into thick, extruded 3D solid with rounded edges
Apply semi-transparent cyan/blue ice material with subsurface scattering
Replace original high-contrast red/white colors with unified ice palette (translucent blue body, white highlights)
decorate: Glossy surface highlights to define edge curvature
Rim lighting to separate object from white background
Soft ambient occlusion shadow at the base
forbid: Using the original brand red color for the character body or background
Changing the font style, stroke thickness, or breaking the character structure
Adding external props like headphones, microphones, or sound waves outside the character
Opaque white or plastic material (must be translucent ice)
generation_brief: 3D render of the Chinese character '听' made of thick translucent cyan-blue ice, centered on a pure white background. The character has rounded edges, glossy surface, and internal trapped air bubbles. Strong rim lighting, subsurface scattering, soft contact shadow, and small melting water puddle at the base. Photorealistic C4D/Octane style.
color_application: Strictly replace original red/white scheme with theme's ice palette. The character body becomes translucent cyan/pale ice blue. Highlights are pure white. Shadows/refractions are deep blue. No red is allowed.
stroke_application: Remove all 2D outlines. Define the character's strokes through 3D volume, beveled edges, and light refraction. Edges must be smooth and rounded to simulate carved/melted ice.
composition_application: Centered composition. The 3D character occupies 60-70% of the canvas. Use a slightly elevated 3/4 view to show thickness. Pure white studio background with subtle ground shadow.
identity_application: Preserve the exact 2D footprint and stroke logic of the '听' character. Recognizability relies on the precise geometric structure of the left '口' and right '斤' components, rendered as a single cohesive ice sculpture.
fidelity_constraints: Must use semi-transparent ice/crystal material with subsurface scattering
Must include internal details like bubbles or snowflakes
Must have a clean white background with physical grounding shadows
Must maintain the exact structural proportions of the '听' character
negative_constraints: No opaque plastic or metal materials
No complex scenery or text watermarks
No distortion of the character's stroke logic
